checkedAlternates.risk: UTF-8 can encode up to 4 bytes per character.
checkedAlternates.resolution: UTF-8 uses 8-bit (1-byte) code units (group-4), whereas UTF-16 uses 16-bit code units (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Shift JIS encodes Japanese characters in 2 bytes.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Shift JIS is a variable-length byte stream built on 8-bit code units (group-4).
